description:
Score up to 10 US locations in one request.

Use this for a list: properties, branches, listings, sites.

Each location counts as one call against your allowance, so a list of ten costs ten. A location that cannot be resolved is reported in errors rather than failing the request.

address.description: A US address. Give this or lat/lon.

label.description: Your name for this location, echoed back so you can match results to inputs.

name: score_many
